cases.explain: «оскорбительный ответ» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “Suppose I make the attempt. What does it mean?” she said, evidently giving utterance to a thought, a thousand times thought over and learned by heart. “It means that I, hating him, but still recognizing that I have wronged him—and I consider him magnanimous—that I humiliate myself to write to him. … Well, suppose I make the effort; I do it. Either I receive a humiliating refusal or consent. … Well, I have received his consent, say. …” Anna was at that moment at the furthest end of the room, and she stopped there, doing something to the curtain at the window. “I receive his consent, but my … my son? They won’t give him up to me. He will grow up despising me, with his father, whom I’ve abandoned. Do you see, I love … equally, I think, but both more than myself—two creatures, Seryozha and Alexey.”

cases.sentence: Она нагнула голову и исподлобья смотрела сияющими ___ на маленькую, худенькую и жалкую в своей штопаной кофточке и ночном чепчике, всю дрожавшую от волнения Долли.
cases.explain: «мокрыми глазами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: She came out into the middle of the room and stood facing Dolly, with her arms pressed tightly across her chest. In her white dressing gown her figure seemed more than usually grand and broad. She bent her head, and with shining, wet eyes looked from under her brows at Dolly, a thin little pitiful figure in her patched dressing jacket and nightcap, shaking all over with emotion.

cases.sentence: Воспоминания о доме и детях с особенною, новою для нее прелестью, в каком-то ___ возникали в ее воображении.
cases.explain: «новом сиянии» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Left alone, Darya Alexandrovna said her prayers and went to bed. She had felt for Anna with all her heart while she was speaking to her, but now she could not force herself to think of her. The memories of home and of her children rose up in her imagination with a peculiar charm quite new to her, with a sort of new brilliance. That world of her own seemed to her now so sweet and precious that she would not on any account spend an extra day outside it, and she made up her mind that she would certainly go back next day.

cases.sentence: Этот ее мир показался ей теперь так дорог и мил, что она ни за что не хотела вне его провести ___ и решила, что завтра непременно уедет.
cases.explain: «лишний день» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
